integrity: The exact formula is supported by a direct all-n proof. Exhaustive checks of all idempotents through degree nine corroborate but are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only finite total increasing regressive transformations. The enumeration is for the full commuting-element centralizer of a specified idempotent, not for all monotone maps or only commuting idempotents. Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed; undiscovered implicit older equivalences remain possible.
title: Centralizers of arbitrary predecessor idempotents in the Catalan monoid
